per_object_cap.stated: ZFS limits individual files to ~18000 Petabytes (16 exbibytes).
per_object_cap.notes: It is unlikely that you will encounter this limit.

retention.stated: All accounts have seven daily snapshots free of charge.
retention.notes: You do not need to set up or maintain these snapshots - they are automatically created and rotated.

interface_detail: Any SSH tool: rsync, sftp, scp, borg, rclone, restic, git-annex; zfs send/recv on request
tooling: The canonical rclone/restic/borg/rsync target. Every backend works because it is a real filesystem.
chaining: SSHFS mount -> AList -> Cloudflare. No HTTP object API, so a wrapper is mandatory for serving
limits_note: 800 GB minimum; price falls in bands only at 10 TB and 100 TB
reliability_note: Operating since 2001, 7 daily + 4 weekly snapshots on 10 TB+ accounts, physical media shipment. The expensive-but-unbreakable end of the market.
confidence_note: the pricing page states an 800 GB minimum order
